summary: V26.p tested end-to-end. All 3 UI enhancements work: (1) Nuovo Appuntamento gained phone_mobile, phone_work, phone_target selector chips (only shown when Telefonico toggle ON) and full_address; auto-fill via contact pill works; POST/GET/PUT roundtrip validated. (2) Nuova Ritelefonata has new cb-phone field with correct placeholder and helper text; can create callback with phone-only (no contact). (3) Home banner slideshow interval confirmed at 10000ms via code inspection (home.tsx:72). Backend pytest suite 7/7 passed. UI validated with Playwright (mobile viewport 390x844) — created via UI, verified persisted via API, cleaned up. No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: appointment/new.tsx: pill onPress for contact resets phone_target to 'mobile' if c.phone exists — good; but user opinion may prefer keeping previous selection. Not a bug.
callback/new.tsx: no validation that either contact_id OR phone is provided — allows callback with no phone AND no contact (only title). Acceptable per spec (phone is optional).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testIDs present, POST persisted, chips work)
